causal_route: HEART: TAC -> DEBAND -> RE-TAC produces challenge resistance; however initial load is preconditioning/compensatory hypertrophy rather than a directly established mature fibrotic lock. SKIN: long PGT -> withdrawal produces recurrence, supporting latent mechanical memory but not challenge resistance.

fate_contrast.H1: benefit disappears or pathology re-emerges after retuning withdrawal
fate_contrast.H3A: prior transient mechanical history reduces response to a later same-class adverse challenge before mature lock is established
fate_contrast.H3B: after directly established mature pathological lock, delayed retuning plus withdrawal causes durable resistance to the same adverse rechallenge

timing_gate.H3A_heart_initial_state: short TAC 3d or 1w; significant compensatory hypertrophy, no direct mature fibrotic-lock establishment required or demonstrated
timing_gate.H3B_required_initial_state: directly measured mature pathological mechanical/fibrotic lock before retuning
